entities.name: Jek
entities.description: An Azorius hieromancer in-training on Ravnica and Lavinia's brother, killed by Rakdos.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: The guild that wanted its key back.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: Guild whose band hunted the siblings.

entities.name: the albino
entities.description: Albino man leading the Rakdos band.

entities.name: Halok
entities.description: Person in the school of hieromancers to whom Jek told Vinni to bring the key.

entities.name: Dimir key
entities.description: A Dimir-marked key, evidence of a crime.

events.summary: Jek and Vinni obtain a Dimir key and the Dimir organize Rakdos to hunt them.
events.quote: The Dimir wanted the key back and organized a band of Rakdos led by an albino man

events.summary: Rakdos track them to their Ninth District apartment and they flee; Jek binds the Spike Jester.
events.quote: Jek then cast a binding glyph on the jester and kicked him away.

events.summary: The albino and an ogre catch them; Jek is wounded and sliced across the chest.
events.quote: the albino managed to slice his chest with a blade

events.summary: Vinni stabs the albino and, with Jek's blue-fire dagger, kills the ogre.
events.quote: Vinni avenging him by stabbing the albino through his throat with her dagger

events.summary: Jek gives Vinni the key, tells her to be strong, and dies in her arms.
events.quote: told Vinni - Lavinia , as her full name was, to be strong, then died in her arms

relations.quote: he was killed by a band of Rakdos who were hunting for him
